maria-cs: Summit Corp asked to onboard a custom 13B summarizer to Private (VPC) with HSM + PHI controls. They're saying renewal depends on getting this live in Q2 — can we scope constraints and an eval plan?
chris-se: @maria-cs quick q: do we have the model repo/license and a data residency statement? also need to know which PHI categories they expect to process.
maria-cs: Customer note pasted: 'fork of open-13b, training on visit summaries (US only). Must redact PHI on ingest, use HSM for key management, and keep logs off-network.' They uploaded a read-only folder: https://drive.redwood/summit-onboard
lee-ml: For safety/evals: recommend a privacy-preserving eval + a PHI-leakage sweep. Plan: 200 labeled summaries for ROUGE + factuality checks, plus 150 adversarial prompts. Also run regen tests for hallucination rate threshold.
chris-se: Operational constraints: Private + HSM requires infra approval and an SSO/KMS mapping. Also confirm latency SLOs — Summit expects median <300ms at 512 tokens. Any flexibility?
maria-cs: Summit said "under 300ms median is a must for front-end UI". They can accept a short canary first week.
devops-bot: ticket CS-5891 created: Onboard Summit Corp 13B -> Private (VPC) + HSM + PHI evals. https://issues.redwood/CS-5891
sam_engineer: I can own the runbook and deployment steps. Can we schedule an enablement + kickoff call Wed 10am PT? I'll bring the private deployment checklist and rollback play.
maria-cs: Wed 10am PT works for Summit. Marking internal priority: HIGH — renewal risk if >6 weeks slip. @sales-ops FYI.
chris-se: I'll loop infra & solutions and draft a cost/throughput estimate today. tagging @lee-ml for eval runner prep. :thumbsup:
lee-ml: I'll prep the eval harness and a small synthetic PHI redaction test. Will post the test vectors here before the call. :eyes:
sam_engineer: noted. I'll add pre-kickoff items to the ticket: network diagram, KMS ARN, model artifact link, expected qps.
maria-cs: thanks all — let's try to have the canary plan and eval checklist ready by Tue EOD so Wed call can be focused on signoffs. :raised_hands:
